narr: A cold front moved through southern New England during the early evening triggering a few severe thunderstorms in northern Massachusetts.
ev: In Westport, Cheryl's Way was flooded with debris and rocks in the road. Report relayed by amateur radio.
In New Bedford, Dartmouth Street at Rockdale Avenue was flooded to the point where DPW assistance was required. Padanaram Ave. was also flooded. Report relayed by amateur radio.
lsr: 60 CHERYLS WAY - FLOODED WITH DEBRIS AND ROCKS IN THE ROAD PER LAW ENFORCEMENT REPORTED BY AMATEUR RADIO.
REPORTED BY AMATEUR RADIO DARTMOUTH STREET AT ROCKDALE AVENUE - FLOODED TO THE POINT WHERE DPW ASSISTANCE IS REQUESTED, ORCHARD STREET AT PADNARAM AVENUE STREET FLOODING PER FIRE DEPT/RESCUE.
